The Miss Harrison of St Cross, Weybridge with whom CMY corresponded in 1887 was probably the Fanny Harrison of that address who was a member of the London Library. She may also have been the Fanny Harrison who published Our Teacher\'s Stories: Attractive stories for Boys and Girls (London: Mowbray 1888).
